title: Arctic Norway: Winter Wonderland
alt: A Havila coastal ship in a snowy harbour under the Arctic winter light
transport: Airport transfers, a two-night Havila coastal voyage from Tromsø to Kirkenes and a flight to Oslo

expert.name: Ingrid
expert.quote: For the northern lights you need three things: darkness, a clear sky and patience. Tromsø gives you the first two; we build in the third.
expert.tip: Book the aurora chase for your first night in the north, not the last. If the sky stays cloudy, most operators let you join again free of charge.

summary: Eight winter days in the far north: two nights in Tromsø, two nights on the Havila coastal ship round the top of Norway to Kirkenes, then two nights and a sightseeing day in Oslo.
included: Included: all transfers and rail or ferry journeys as listed; sightseeing and cruises as listed with tickets where stated; daily breakfast.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; lunches and dinners unless stated; travel insurance; optional excursions; personal expenses. Hotels are quoted as a class and named on confirmation.
